props.name: children
props.description: The chart's parts. Root never inspects them. The plot is one tab stop. ArrowRight and ArrowLeft move to the next and previous point, by x and then y, and Home and End go to the first and last point. ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the series focus, all series first, and the walk then stays in the focused series. Enter and Space pin the tooltip, and Escape hides it.

props.name: config
props.description: One entry per series, keyed by the values of the `seriesKey` column. Each entry is a `ChartSeriesConfig` with `label`, `color` and optionally `format` and `icon`. It takes no `stack`, `projectedFrom`, `interval`, `missing`, `qualityKey` or `barVariant`, and its colour is a role, never a scale, a role list or a threshold. Write it `as const satisfies ChartConfig`. The legend lists the keys in config order, and JavaScript orders keys that read as integers, such as "2026", first and ascending, so name a year's series, such as `thisYear`.

props.name: data
props.description: Long rows, one per point: an x, a y and the series the point belongs to. Repeated x values and repeated points are valid, and every one draws. A row whose x or y is null or undefined has no point. Every cell is serialisable, so a server component passes it. On a data update the axes glide to fit the new points over the chart's update time. They move at once under reduced motion and when the chart holds more than 5,000 points.

props.name: data-intro
props.description: "none" turns the entrance off. By default the marks sweep in from the left, by x, the first time a third of the plot is in view, and reduced motion draws them at rest.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles, with every public chart custom property typed. `--chart-hover-dim` is the opacity of the marks outside the active slot or slice, 0.45 by default, and 1 turns the dim off. Dot rings, seams and label halos paint `--surface`, the opaque fill the chart rests on, and the muted text on them reads `--surface-muted-foreground`. Fuse's opaque containers, such as Card, Frame.Panel, Alert, Dialog and Popover, set both, and the page's `--background` is the fallback. On a fill of your own, set both beside it: with `background: var(--muted)`, set `--surface: var(--muted)` and `--surface-muted-foreground: var(--muted-foreground)`. A translucent tint keeps the surface beneath it, and an image or a gradient has no colour for the cut-outs to match.
